subject.title: fix(gateway): keep hot reload subsystems consistent during channel deferral

question: Does the security owner approve the final credential, secrets-snapshot, and shared-session-generation publication and rollback semantics after the branch is rebased?
rationale: The patch changes security-owned runtime credential and secret-state boundaries; source review found no concrete vulnerability, but repository policy and CODEOWNERS require explicit owner judgment for this expanded behavior.

options.title: Approve after rebase and proof
options.body: Security owners review the exact rebased head and approve its revision fencing, rollback, and auth/session ownership semantics after current-head live proof is added.

options.title: Narrow security-owned scope
options.body: Remove or split the auth, secrets, and session-generation changes if they are not required for the original hooks and cron invariant.

options.title: Pause the transaction
options.body: Do not land the PR until a different security-state design is agreed if the rollback and ownership model is not acceptable.

recommendation.title: Approve after rebase and proof
recommendation.body: Security owners review the exact rebased head and approve its revision fencing, rollback, and auth/session ownership semantics after current-head live proof is added.

likelyOwner.reason: CODEOWNERS assigns the changed secrets and auth-profile boundaries to this team.
